items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: In the saxophone section, as I say, we had Darnell Howard, Omer Simeon on lead sax, James Mundy on tenor sax, Cecil Irwin on tenor sax

ctx.x: That's right, he was there. He was there with his wife. That's right. Him and Hilliard sat together.
You have George Dixon -- in the brass section we had George Dixon, Charlie Allen, Walter Fuller, and we had so many other trumpet players, man, I can't think of all of them.

items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: That first band we had was a great band, because we had two fiddles, we had Darnell Howard on fiddle, and Jimmy Mundy on fiddle

ctx.x: What were some of the things you arranged?

I can't remember too many of them. A lot of the arranging we did was popular music. Back in them days they didn't have the guys, you know, to come around singing and going on, what'd they call them, tune pluggers. You didn't have them back in them days. So the different representatives from the publishing companies would come by Grand Terrace, and each one of them had their own arrangement -- own arranger. They'd pick out to do arranging on a new tune they got coming out. So I did a lot of those, Budd Johnson did…
Cecil Irwin did some arranging, too, didn't he?
